title: Comfort Club Coverage Chargeback Rate and Covered-Repair History
content:
On cancellation of a Comfort Club Maintenance Agreements agreement, the covered-repair benefit drawn in the current term is charged back at a coverage chargeback rate that reflects the agreement's tenure and its covered-repair history.

## Coverage chargeback rule
- An agreement in at least its **tenth** consecutive term (a count of 10 or more) with **no covered-repair draw dated within the 24 months before the date of handling, apart from draws charged to the current term**, has the long-standing coverage rate of **0.25**.
- An agreement in at least its **fifth** consecutive term (a count of 5 or more) that does not meet that condition has the steady-member coverage rate of **0.5**.
- Any other agreement: no reduced rate under this rule.

Draws charged to the current term are set aside for the 24-month test: only earlier terms' draws dated within the 24 months count against the long-standing rate.

## Combinations

| Consecutive term count | Draws within 24 months outside the current term | Coverage chargeback rate |
|---|---|---|
| 10 or more | none | 0.25 |
| 10 or more | one or more | 0.5 |
| 5 to 9 | any | 0.5 |
| 4 or fewer | any | no reduced rate |

## Example (hypothetical, 600.00 drawn in the current term)
- 11th term, the only draws in 24 months are in the current term: 600.00 multiplied by 0.25 gives 150.00.
- 11th term, a draw 14 months ago in the previous term: 600.00 multiplied by 0.5 gives 300.00.
- 6th term: 600.00 multiplied by 0.5 gives 300.00.
